ENGINEERING GUIDE

How to Prepare an Anodizing Line Project Brief

Prepare the product, capacity, factory and automation information needed for a useful aluminium anodizing line quotation.

PROJECT PLANNING / DAIMENG TECHNOLOGY

A clear brief helps suppliers compare the same project. Prepare a small set of practical documents before asking for a quotation.

Products and quality

Share drawings or a product family list covering dimensions, alloy, weight and surface area when available. State the finish requirements, inspection approach and the customer specifications you need to satisfy.

Demand and production mix

Record current demand, the expected ramp-up and your planning horizon. Split demand by product family and finish. Include operating shifts and working days so output targets can be interpreted consistently.

Factory and utilities

Provide a dimensioned building layout with columns, access points and clear height. Identify available electrical supply, water, cooling, compressed air, extraction and wastewater treatment interfaces. Mark which infrastructure already exists and which must be included in the project.

Automation and information

Describe operator tasks, batch identification, reporting and any connection to existing factory software. Involve both production and IT teams. List the information to exchange before choosing a communication method.

Delivery and responsibility

Separate the scope into equipment supply, civil work, installation, commissioning, training and ongoing service. Record the responsible party for each item. Agree how acceptance will be measured using representative products and operating conditions.

A concise enquiry checklist

  • Country, location and project stage
  • Product dimensions, alloy and finish requirements
  • Monthly output target and planned operating schedule
  • Factory drawings and available utilities
  • Control, reporting and traceability requirements
  • Desired timing and supply responsibilities

Use the enquiry form to prepare the first version of your brief. You can download a copy before submitting it.
